newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures expand gains, hit highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures expand gains, hit highs.

text.p: May 1 - U.S. stock index futures expanded gains, hit day's peaks. June S&P 500s tailed T-bond futures up as busy opening trade slowed. They said June S&Ps could head higher, possibly test 810.00 Wednesday high, but they also expected hesitation before Friday's April US jobs report. Fair value 3.75 pts over. Arb buys seen at 4.50 pts over, sells at 2.95 pts over. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
